attributes.action: Make lakes and open water safer for children
attributes.additional_details: Making open water safer so children can’t enter and prevent life’s being taken
attributes.background: Require large lakes, ponds and other open water near homes, schools, parks, playgrounds and footpaths to have appropriate child-safety measures, including secure barriers where necessary. Children can reach dangerous water in seconds, and stronger prevention could save lives

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Place safety measures around dangerous open water
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782128
